behavior_contract.normal_oracle: The builder forwards AttributeInputTypeEnum.BOOLEAN to AttributeChoicesHandler; fetch returns static Yes/No choices and does not call GraphQL.
behavior_contract.mutant_oracle: The unchanged handler receives undefined and therefore calls GraphQL instead of returning static choices.
source_anchors: Handler.ts: Boolean attributes do not expose choices; BOOLEAN returns createBooleanOptions().
AttributeQueryVarsBuilder.ts: selected attribute type is destructured and passed as the fourth AttributeChoicesHandler argument.
behavior_contract.collateral_behavior_assessment: The replacement changes only the fourth argument at the default AttributeChoicesHandler construction site. The handler branches on this argument only for BOOLEAN; non-BOOLEAN inputs keep the existing GraphQL path.

admission_reason: The independent BOOLEAN builder probe passes on normal and fails on the mutant after the unchanged handler takes the GraphQL path. Both snapshots load and execute assertions. The one-site edit changes only the type argument at the AttributeChoicesHandler construction boundary.
